evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament are intact.
evidence.MCL: Prior healed traumatic injury to the medial collateral ligament proximal attachment.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Small medial meniscal body undersurface tear with a flipped fragment in the medial aspect of the medial tibial plateau
evidence.Medial OA: Moderate chondrosis with area of more than 50% thinning of cartilage.
evidence.PF OA: Mild to moderate chondrosis with a focal full-thickness fissure with subchondral bone change at the medial aspect of the lateral patellar facet.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral bone change at the medial aspect of the lateral patellar facet.
evidence.Fracture: Remote avulsion injury at the proximal medial collateral ligament and fibular head.
